classification.difficultyReason: Choose polygonal cross-sections, including decomposing a rhombus using its diagonals, before applying V=Ah.

content.prompt: Find the volume of each of the following solids.

spec.description: Upright triangular prism with top cross-section, highlighted altitude and separate concealed lower rear edge. All four printed dimensions remain.
spec.mathematics: Top triangular base 4 m, perpendicular altitude 2 m, prism height 7 m; additional triangular edge 3 m. The hidden solid edge is black dashed; the altitude remains semantic red.

spec.description: Rhombic prism extending upper-right, four matching double ticks, two red dashed diagonals, intersection right-angle mark and external prism-length dimension.
spec.mathematics: Leader from 0.72 m meets the steep diagonal; leader from 1.13 m meets the long near-horizontal diagonal. Full-diagonal interpretation gives area 0.4068 m². Six faces are identified separately from diagonal construction.
spec.answerVisibility: Only printed measurements and marks are visible.

answer.worked:
The equal-sided cross-section is a rhombus. Its diagonals bisect each other, forming four right triangles.
$$\begin{align*}A&=4\times\frac{\left(0.72\div2\right)\left(1.13\div2\right)}{2}\\A&=0.4068\text{ m}^2\\V&=Ah\\V&=0.4068\times1.07\\V&=0.435276\text{ m}^3\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Low trapezoidal prism, near-left connecting face, right trapezoidal cross-section, two distinct 2 m labels, parallel arrows and red dashed altitude.
spec.mathematics: Interpreted trapezium parallel sides 2 m and 5 m, altitude 2 m, extrusion length 4 m. Upper-left 2 m attachment remains subject to review because the source label has no leader. Eight vertices and six faces are identified.
spec.answerVisibility: Source measurements only; no calculated values.
